data.rationale: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Inventory + Prepaids
Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Gift Cards
Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Other Reserves
Inventory = DC Stock + Store Stock + Goods in Transit
Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Intangibles + Other
Non-Current Liabilities = Bank Facility & Leases + Deferred Tax + Provisions
Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Lease Payments + Dividends
Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions

data.expression: SUM(cf-ni, cf-da, cf-dar, cf-dinv, cf-dap, cf-dwc)
data.rationale: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit After Tax + D&A + Working Capital
Cost of Goods Sold = Merchandise Cost + Freight & DC + Markdowns & Shrink
Depreciation & Amortisation = Store Fit-out + Right-of-Use + IT & POS
Operating Profit (EBIT) = EBITDA − D&A
EBIT Margin % = EBIT / Net Sales x 100
EBITDA = Gross Profit − Operating Expenses
EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Net Sales x 100
Profit Before Tax = EBIT + Net Financial Items
Free Cash Flow = CFO + CapEx
Gross Profit = Net Sales − Cost of Goods Sold
Gross Margin % = Gross Profit / Net Sales x 100
Profit After Tax = Profit Before Tax − Income Tax
Net Margin % = Profit After Tax / Net Sales x 100
Net Financial Items = Finance Income − Finance Costs + Other
Operating Expenses = Store Personnel & Operations + Rent & Occupancy + Marketing, E-commerce, Logistics & HQ
Net Sales = Gross Sales − Returns, Discounts & Member Bonus
